title: UX-4 the SSH key this host holds for one device
description: GET /v1/ssh/key. An inventory, never a key: fingerprints only, and only for the device on the request's credential. It exists so a companion can find out that the host's `authorized_keys` line and its own private half have come apart before the terminal fails, rather than after.

device_id.description: The device on this request's credential, echoed. A device that reinstalled can hold a credential issued to an identity other than the one it calls itself, and this is the host's own answer to which one it is.

authorized.description: Whether this host holds any key for this device at all. False is the state a reinstalled device that was never re-paired finds itself in.

fingerprint.description: The newest owned line, which for this module's own lines is the last one in the file. Null when the host holds none.

fingerprints.description: Every owned line for this device, oldest first. More than one means a drift that `omodachi-host ssh list --prune` cleans up.
